body.name: Compact regular finite-fiber class
body.construction: Conditional on the source-prime chart hypothesis and successful finite output of \(\mathrm{thm:conditional\mbox{-}geometric\mbox{-}resolution}\), for fixed \(G,n,e\) with \(d_e(G)<\infty\), select \(\mathcal C_{G,e}\) as in \(\mathrm{def:regular\mbox{-}cell}\) and let \(\mathcal K_G\subset\mathcal C_{G,e}\) be any nonempty compact set with nonempty relative interior in that cell.
